South Korea public holidays for 2025, including the 설날 (Seollal) and 추석 (Chuseok) three-day blocks and 대체공휴일 (substitute holidays) where a holiday falls on a weekend or overlaps another. Lunar dates (설날/추석/부처님오신날) and substitute-holiday designations should be pulled from the official 관공서의 공휴일 notice for production.
